serialize_config_to_json: convert a typed config object with annotated fields into a JSON-serializable dictionary
convert_value_to_json: recursively convert a typed value to JSON handling Union, List, Dict, Tuple, and Enum types
check_optional_type: check if a typing class is an Optional type by inspecting Union args for None
extend_tuple_type: expand a variable-length tuple type annotation to match the number of values provided
get_class_origin_type: extract the origin type from a typing module class across Python 3.6 and 3.7
